about_the_game:
The Long Fall Home

The year is 1969. The world is watching as Apollo 11 prepares to make history. But behind the scenes, NASA launches a secret initiative: four brave blue-collar volunteers are selected to join the mission, not to walk on the Moon, but to be cryogenically frozen in a lunar research hub. The plan? Wake them up in 1975 when the next crew arrives and study the long-term effects of lunar exposure on the human body.

That mission never happens.

NASA loses its funding. The world moves on. The volunteers? Forgotten. Until the hub’s power fails in 2025, and they thaw out naturally, confused, dazed, and completely alone.

But the Moon isn’t the same. And neither is space.

As they leave the surface, they’re met with a cosmic fever dream, massive yellow submarines floating aimlessly, whales soaring through the void, asteroids being mined by unknown forces, alien ships locked in battle, and everyday objects blown up to absurd proportions, like they just drifted out of a deranged thrift store.

Is this the future? A hallucination? Or are they still frozen, trapped in a bizarre dream?

With only each other and their wits, the four survivors must navigate an interstellar obstacle course of gravity-defying puzzles, physics-based platforming, and mind-bending hazards, all while piecing together what really happened during their 56-year sleep.

Will they find a way home? Or will they be lost in the madness of deep space forever?

🌌 1-4 Player Co-op – Play solo or with friends as you stumble through the unknown, working together to solve puzzles and overcome bizarre challenges.
🚀 Surreal Space Exploration – Traverse a world where logic takes a backseat, and the impossible is just another Tuesday.
🧩 Physics-Based Puzzles – Manipulate objects, master momentum, and solve obstacles using teamwork and ingenuity.
🎭 A Mind-Bending Mystery – Unravel the truth behind your fate while questioning what’s real and what’s the ramblings of a cryo-frozen brain.

You went to sleep in 1969.
You woke up in chaos.
Now, you just need to get home.

Will you make The Long Fall Home?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, or 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (such as Intel HD 4000 or comparable) with DirectX 11 support
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i7 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 or RX 6700XT
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: THE LONG FALL HOME is a precision puzzle-platformer for 1-4 players. Waking from cryo-sleep decades too late, you must navigate a surreal, shifting space of bizarre obstacles and cosmic oddities. Solve physics-based puzzles, overcome traps, and uncover the truth on your long journey back to Earth.
